scenes.title: The Prediction Problem
scenes.purpose: Establish the premise that a neural network maps input features to an initial prediction through weighted connections.
scenes.narration: A neural network is a system that learns from examples. Given an input, it produces a prediction.
scenes.visual: Warm ivory canvas opens with a top progress tracker and title card. Input nodes [x1, x2] illuminate in electric ultramarine, passing forward pulses through faint synaptic lines to an output neuron emitting an uncertain prediction badge.

layout.portrait: Top chapter progress bar, hero headline at top: 96px, central bipartite network stage at top: 320px, bottom takeaway card at bottom: 100px

beats.action: Headline rises from mask; chapter stepper activates on Step 1
Input feature nodes illuminate with numeric tags (x1=0.85, x2=0.15)
Synaptic connection filaments stroke forward with traveling light pulses
Output neuron blooms and emits prediction badge (y_hat = 0.28)

transition_out.continuity: Network nodes and connections seamlessly expand into multi-layer hidden architecture

audio_cues.description: A neural network is a system that learns from examples.
Tactile micro-click on input node illumination
Subtle data flow swoosh on forward signal transmission
Soft chime on prediction badge emission

scenes.title: The Forward Pass
scenes.purpose: Illustrate information flow across hidden layers with linear transformations and non-linear activations.
scenes.narration: Information flows forward through layers of connected nodes, each applying a simple transformation.
scenes.visual: The network expands into a 3-tier deep architecture. Amber signal packets glide from input through hidden nodes (h1, h2, h3). An interactive math badge expands showing the dot-product transformation, while activation halos pulse.

layout.portrait: Top chapter progress bar (Step 2), hero headline, deep 3-layer neural network across central viewport, bottom formula chip

beats.action: Camera pushes slightly forward (scale: 1.04); stepper highlights Step 2
Hidden layer nodes illuminate with formula callout (z = Wa + b)
Activation glow pulses (sigma) across hidden nodes in marigold amber
Directional signal stream traverses from hidden layer into the output node

transition_out.continuity: Output neuron position maintained while ground truth target aligns beside it

audio_cues.description: Information flows forward through layers of connected nodes...
Node expansion pop and crisp keyboard thock

scenes.title: The Loss & Gradient
scenes.purpose: Explain error calculation and the mechanics of backpropagation adjusting synaptic weights.
scenes.narration: The network compares its prediction to the correct answer. The difference — the loss — tells it how to adjust every weight.
scenes.visual: A target ground-truth beacon snaps in next to the prediction. A discrepancy bracket highlights the delta error, popping up a vermilion Loss badge (L = 0.52). Suddenly, a vibrant reverse gradient pulse surges backward through all connections, visibly updating weight thicknesses.

layout.portrait: Top progress bar (Step 3), upper error comparison meter, central network with reverse vermilion gradient flow, bottom weight delta formula

beats.action: Ground truth target beacon locks in emerald green; stepper advances to Step 3
Discrepancy error bracket snaps between prediction and truth; Loss badge triggers
Backpropagation wave: intense coral vermilion pulse flows right-to-left
Synaptic weight lines dynamically thicken and morph; weight values adapt

transition_out.continuity: Loss scalar transforms into the starting coordinates of the 2D loss basin curve

audio_cues.description: The network compares its prediction to the correct answer...
Urgent error impact thud on loss calculation
Reverse whoosh glide as backpropagation wave fires
Mechanical ratchet toggle latch on weight updates

scenes.title: Convergence & Mastery
scenes.purpose: Demonstrate gradient descent error minimization over training epochs to achieve high-accuracy convergence.
scenes.narration: Repeat this across many examples, and the loss falls. The network learns.
scenes.visual: A smooth Catmull-Rom loss basin curve draws. An emerald marble descends rapidly down the slope, taking micro-steps. Epoch counter rolls 1 to 500 while loss drops 0.52 to 0.02. The entire network locks into a golden synchronized pulse with a monumental stat.

layout.portrait: Top progress bar (Step 4 Complete), upper loss curve visualization, central monument stat, bottom accuracy badge

beats.action: Loss basin curve reveals with gradient fill; descent marker starts at peak
Marker accelerates down the gradient slope toward the minimum
Epoch roll surges from 1 to 500; loss rolls down from 0.52 to 0.02
Monument stat locks (99.4% ACCURACY); golden checkmark badge stamps

transition_out.continuity: Final converged monument state holds cleanly with subtle glow breathing

audio_cues.description: Repeat this across many examples, and the loss falls...
Triumphant resonant chime on convergence lock
